title: Vet Metric3 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vet:metric3
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day vet metric3 (3) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on vet metric3 (3) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It rates what time of day your vet metric3 (3) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
